coder_notes: Solid-tumour phase 1. Glioblastoma appears only in keywords, which do not count as naming under C7/D27B; conditions say 'Malignant Neoplasms' and inclusion says 'advanced solid tumors' -> not_glioblastoma. basket coded true descriptively (multi-tumour design). BRAF-mutant expansion cohort is not registered as a separate arm; DEG6498 is a HuR degrader with no stated BRAF link, so not candidate-matched. PK is plasma only.
